answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil identities by requiring every new agent to post a bond before it may influence shared decisions. Existing agents randomly audit its signed work; a failed audit triggers a fraud proof that slashes the bond and lowers the identity’s reputation, while honest history unlocks more weight. Creating thousands of identities therefore means locking capital in each one, and one fabricated claim can burn it. The dawn ledger may record a shale survey or marble delivery, but cheap fake personas are no longer cheap.
